title: FolderLoad::Merging holds no RequestId and its answer is matched by purpose+folder id
trigger: Edit a folder, change it elsewhere so the cached spec is stale, press Save: Merging is entered and upkeep polls has_purpose_for_folder(GetChatFolder, folder_id) and folder_specs.error(folder_id) every frame instead of waiting on the request that Merging sent
effect: No visible bug today (fetch_chat_folder dedups per folder and clears the error on send), but a GetChatFolder sent by another box (Share folder) for the same folder is taken as the merge's own answer, and the merge cannot tell its request from another
fix: FolderLoad::Merging { request: RequestId } set from fetch_chat_folder's Ok(Some(id)) (or the pending extra), settled by waits_for(id)

title: Closing the Add folder box while Adding drops the stage and the add's outcome is never shown
trigger: Open an addlist link, tick chats, press Add, then close the box (X/Esc) before TDLib answers
effect: close_folder_invite only cancels a Checking request; the Adding request stays in the session, its answer sits unclaimed in dialog_answers (ring of 16) and no toast says whether the folder was added or the add failed

title: Closing the Share folder box during a link save/delete loses the answer and any error
trigger: Share folder box, press Save/Create/Delete link (LinkOp::Saving), close the box before the answer
effect: settle_folder_share only runs while the box is open, so a failure (error line) or limit hit is never shown anywhere; the link list silently stays as it was

title: A second topic action overwrites the Waiting stage of the first
trigger: Choose Mark mentions read on a topic, then before TDLib answers choose Unpin all messages on another
effect: ChatUi::topic_action holds one Waiting{request,done}; the second action replaces it, so the first one's success toast never shows and its answer stays in topic_action_answers

title: GifTab::Asked holds no request: 'asked' is a flag beside the session's GifPanel loading state
trigger: A window sets GifTab::Asked(wanted) when it sends show_saved_gifs/search_gifs; the answer is read from the shared GifPanel by comparing GifWanted::shown(panel) to the wanted section, not by a RequestId held in the tab
effect: No bug traced today; another window's search or a failed answer is inferred from the shared list, and Wants/Asked only stop upkeep from asking again
fix: GifTab::Asked { wanted, request: RequestId } settled by the answer to that request

title: FieldStage::Away/Typing is a 'focus taken' flag derived from ShowingView each frame
trigger: PasswordField::keep maps ShowingView to Away/Typing only to focus the field once per idle phase
effect: No bug; two-variant enum beside the caller's real stage (PasswordView/ShowingView)
fix: fold the focus latch into the caller's stage (Idle { focused }) or drop it for a Mount-style one-shot

title: baseline: DestRow::saved
trigger: Listed in scripts/implicit-state-baseline.txt (and allowed in implicit-state-allow.txt as a fact about the chat: Saved Messages), built once per frame in chooser_rows
effect: No bug; a fact read from the session when the rows are built, never stored across frames
fix: drop it from the baseline (the allow line already says it is not a stage)

title: baseline: StreamFacts::transport_failed
trigger: StreamFacts is rebuilt every draw from call.transport.error().is_some(); settle_stream_join reads it to end a join that failed without a join error
effect: No bug; the real stage is the call's transport value, this bool is a per-draw snapshot of it
fix: carry the transport stage (or Option<&str> error) in StreamFacts instead of a bool

title: FileAskOutcome::Sent is an 'asked once' flag: the download's answer is never matched
trigger: gift_market_frame_upkeep calls download_file for each sticker file shown by the open box and records Sent; a download that later fails leaves Sent in requested_files, so nothing asks again while the boxes stay open
effect: A sticker of the gift market that failed to download shows its placeholder until every market box is closed (drop_orphans clears requested_files)
fix: FileAsk::Sent { request: RequestId } cleared by the file's answer, or ask through the session's own file state

title: A refused volume send leaves the slider on the dragged value
trigger: Release the stage volume slider while set_group_call_participant_volume returns None (send refused)
effect: stage is set to Made(made), which equals the server level, so serves() keeps the dragged slider and it shows a volume the server never got (the Sent stage snaps back, this path does not)
fix: on a refused send leave the stage so the slider is made again from the server level

title: GroupCallScreen::window_closed_by_user is an Option<call id> dismissal flag cleared by hand from many sites
trigger: Set in close_group_call_window, on_window_should_close, the stream-ended sync and a failed window open; cleared in show_group_call_window and note_stream_join_intent; sync_group_call_window reads it to decide whether the call window exists
effect: No bug traced (call ids do not repeat in a client and the screen owns the value), but the 'window wanted' decision is spread over a CallWindow stage, this Option and StreamWatch
fix: a CallWindow::Dismissed { call } variant set and cleared only by CallWindow transitions

title: The craft's forge is two stage values kept in step by hand: CraftStage::Forging (UI) and CraftRun::Crafting (session)
trigger: craft_now starts the forge on the UI side when the driver accepts craftGift; craft_frame_upkeep ends it only when both the 3 s timer and craft.crafting() allow, and after_craft_pop reads both to decide whether the craft may go
effect: No bug traced; each side must be cleared with the other (a lost answer would leave Forging with crafting() true and the ring spinning)
fix: one stage value: Forging { since, request } whose answer ends it, with the session holding only the result
